segments.reason: Probe, wrong-option refutation with sure_note, and a retest in S2; the anterior/posterior pairing is carried forward cleanly.
Predict-then-show probes with Why-it-fails feedback; each trap (TR1, TR17, TR18) is refuted by mechanism and retested in S3 and S8.
Strong clinical vignettes (steroid soft belly, reaction-stage calm, still patient); eponym probes separate the correct owner from look-alikes.
Worked film then faded probe with a skip lane; true signs versus Chilaiditi and posture-based view are well separated; S4.fade_t4b repeats one sentence.
Clear first-versus-best ladder and PYQ-frame split; S5.lie gives supine and right-lateral distractors the same feedback node, so the two wrong models are not separated.
Longest management run (eight probes); Graham and Boey are taught here and drilled again in S7; S6.e_deep shows the claim flagged unverified.
Nine probes in a row with no spacing; S7.b2 adds no new stem after S6.g, and S7.n1 and S7.g1 repeat the Graham and gastric-biopsy points already taught.
Cold fresh-stem quiz with one retest per backbone trap (TR1, TR3, TR4, TR5, TR7, TR11, TR12, TR17, TR23); the strongest delayed-retest segment in the module.

best_parts: node S2.why_probe and S2.why_w1: the 'front opens, back bleeds' mechanism with a Why-it-fails refutation that names the artery behind the wall.
nodes S4.walk1 then S4.fade: a worked film followed by a faded probe, with a skip lane at S4.open_ok.
nodes S5.pyqs_t6 and S5.pyqs_t6b: two different wrong frames each get their own feedback, which separates the collapse error from the reversal error.
node S8.q6 to S8.q10: cold, fresh stems, each with a Show-me-why explanation for the trap it tests.
flaws: node S5.lie: the supine and right-lateral distractors both route to S5.lie_t8, so the feedback cannot name which wrong model the learner holds (R9).
node S4.fade_t4b: 'Match the finding in the stem, word for word' appears twice in one feedback node (R4).

claim K80 says free gas shows in 'about 70%' of perforations, while S5.pair_ok, S5.clear_ok, S8.q5_ok and the O5 report text say three-quarters; the examiner lens flags the inconsistency in quoted figures (R6).
node S6.e_deep: claim K53 carries status 'unverified' and the say item carries flag 'unverified'; a visible unverified marker undercuts trust in the learner's path (R8).
nodes S6.g, S7.b1, S7.b2: the Boey items are drilled three times across two segments; S7.b2 adds no new stem (R4, R5).
nodes S6.d and S7.n1: Graham versus Cellan-Jones is taught twice nearly verbatim (R4).
nodes S6.h, S7.g1: the gastric-ulcer biopsy point is taught twice in a row (R4).
segment S7 as a whole: nine probes with no spacing, so the drill becomes click-through by the later nodes (R4, R8).

report_check.headline: mixed is accurate for the misconceived walk, but the headline does not say which qualifier to fix first.
report_check.objectives: All 12 objectives return 'shaky' with near-identical template wording, so the objective-level report does not differentiate (R9).
report_check.traps: All 20 traps return fell_recovered, which overstates durability: the walk shows refutation and recall within 2 to 10 nodes, not a changed belief (R9).
report_check.calibration: overconfident only; the 37 guess-right answers are not reflected (R9, minor).
report_check.next_steps: Ordering (confident errors, then gaps, then shaky) is useful and gives the learner a concrete first action.
report_check.sim_fixes_confirmed: The round-0 friction items are fixed in the patched module: S6.a_walk now has two short messages with no claims; S3.p6 correct label has no tracked-fluid hint; S4.open_t4 no longer half-endorses the trap; S8 is a cold fresh-stem quiz rather than repeats; S7.g2 and S8.q2 duplicates are removed.

sim_check.misconceived: The path separates each wrong model at the point of choice, and the report names the model back. The report's fell_recovered wording and undifferentiated objectives weaken the diagnosis for a learner with this profile.
sim_check.S1_S2_not_patched: Judged on their own: S1 and S2 are clean. They carry no unresolved sim friction.

merge_ideas: Keep S8's cold fresh-stem quiz pattern and add one delayed cold stem for TR3 and TR5 in S7 so the drill does not run nine probes in a row.
Replace S7.b2 (repeat Boey) with a fresh counting stem that uses a new host, so Boey is tested once in S6 and once in S8.
Give S5.lie two separate feedback nodes, one for supine (the usual bed view) and one for right lateral (the side the gas seems to sit on), each naming its wrong model.
Report: make objectives differ by what the path showed (refuted then recovered versus refuted then fell again) and name the qualifier to fix first.
unscored_notes: Not gated. Facts are not judged (CLAUDE.md). No typing, no run-time model, and no broken edge found in the graph walk.
